status: first grouped fold completed; exact native parity passed; more-fold confirmation required
hypothesis: Fixed sampled-index sigma broadens event supervision unevenly when stride changes. Transporting native target mass to the augmented grid may retain rate invariance with better native precision.
control: Completed grouped-fold0 seed0 baseline, same .5/.25/.25 stride policy, 30 epochs ceiling, patience7, model and optimizer
change: For augmented views only, assign each original Gaussian target mass to its nearest retained sampled frame. Keep native-view loss unchanged; no extra auxiliary head, no FPS, no source labels, no inference modification.
mechanism_test: Verify mass conservation, identity on unchanged grids, and unchanged native loss before training. Report native/half/third rate and all event metrics against the matched baseline.
promotion: One-fold result is only feasibility. Extend only on plausible native precision gain with no >.01 reduced-rate loss; require full grouped folds and matched seeds before candidate promotion.
risk: Transport may become too sharp or alias near event boundaries. Do not retune target width after seeing the same fold; reject on failed mechanism or broad robustness regressions.
